title: Government Scholarships Programme Mexico COMECYT-DAAD Promotion
summary: Scholarship for Mexican graduates to complete a doctoral degree in Germany, including a German language course and insurance coverage funded by DAAD, and monthly scholarship payments funded by COMECYT.

degree_levels.notes: Graduates receive a scholarship to complete a doctoral degree.

institutions.notes: German university and, where appropriate, in conjunction with a non-university research Institution.

nationality.notes: Mexican graduates living in Mexico and applying from there.

residence.notes: Physical presence in Germany for doctoral studies.

mandatory.text: Reside in Mexico and apply from there

funding.description: DAAD covers: Intensive German course in Germany with a duration of two (2) months incl. accommodation and cost of living during this period; Financing health insurance, care insurance, casualty insurance and personal liability insurance; Rent subsidy; Refund of TestDaF or DSH exam. COMECYT pays monthly scholarship payments (amount not specified numerically).

application_rounds.notes: No specific dates provided on the page.

Use desktop computer to access application portal
